error[ZBX-E1206]: the store's disk is too full to keep fetched chunks
  while  keeping a fetched chunk of a lazily started image
  cause  the store's disk has less than 256 MiB free; chunk 3 was not kept, the
         read got EIO
  object b3:5555555555555555555555555555555555555555555555555555555555555555
  fix    free space on the disk that holds the store, then read it again
  more   zbx explain E1206
